approval: Owner-directed Vulkan core hardening pass, 2026-08-11: preserve supported functionality and prefer cohesive, maintainable ownership over mechanical file or line reduction.

file_exceptions.reason: Cohesive hot-path uniform resolution and write policy; further physical splitting would scatter one schema across files without reducing state or branching.
Cohesive allocation-free draw preparation and emission path whose state must remain locally reviewable.
Cold logical-device bootstrap keeps one auditable native feature-chain lifetime scope; phase helpers are reviewed through method exceptions.
Canonical resource-root state and publication seam; behavior is already split into responsibility partials and this file keeps the authoritative state map together.
Cohesive material descriptor state machine; splitting storage from transitions would obscure lifetime ownership.
Single descriptor lifetime/retirement authority; keeping creation, publication, and retirement invariants together is safer than a size-only split.
Cohesive secondary-command integration policy with shared allocation-free scratch and fallback invariants.
Single framebuffer wrapper state machine; attachment identity, generation, and native lifetime transitions remain co-located.
Optional vendor bridge interop owner; native handle, feature, and shared-resource lifetime is intentionally audited in one type.
Canonical barrier translation and emission policy; shared scope/layout rules remain together to prevent a second synchronization model.
Cohesive mesh descriptor allocation/publication/reuse state machine on an allocation-sensitive path.
Canonical packet lowering path; numeric layout, dependency capture, and compatibility checks remain locally auditable.
Primary mesh-wrapper state map and construction boundary; responsibility behavior is already split into focused partials.
Canonical command-buffer lifecycle state map; co-location prevents divergent ownership and reset policy.

method_exception_profiles.reason: Cold native bootstrap and extension-table publication require one visible pointer-lifetime and success-commit scope.
Declarative startup capability ledger; each row is intentionally explicit and has no runtime control-flow ownership.
One dynamic/legacy render-scope transition matrix with shared attachment invariants.
Allocation-free secondary integration paths keep fallback, inheritance, and lifetime decisions in one auditable branch tree.
Atomic mesh request/binding snapshots must read one coherent state under the existing synchronization boundary.
Canonical allocation-free schedule construction with one stable ordering and rejection path.
Command-buffer reuse validation and refresh remain atomic against one artifact generation.
One UI secondary recording transaction with tightly coupled inheritance and cleanup.
Single queue-acceptance transaction; splitting would separate receipt publication from accepted-work lifetime transfer.
Descriptor reuse and allocation decisions must observe one coherent generation and binding snapshot.
Single pipeline readiness state machine; creation permission, cache identity, and deferred outcomes remain together.
Allocation-free draw preparation/emission under one caller-owned lock and one prepared-state contract.
One primary preparation/record/reuse transaction with explicit terminal outcomes.
Primary frame-data publication must remain atomic across all prepared draw consumers.
Explicit uniform schema dispatch; the long switch surfaces are the authoritative mapping and avoid runtime reflection or allocation.
Single OpenXR queue-acceptance, wait, and retirement transaction.
Primary finalization commits one command-buffer result and its complete cleanup/diagnostic outcome.
Explicit canonical signature schema; field-by-field hashing remains visible and allocation-free.
One descriptor write transaction over caller-owned native scratch.
Mirror preview records one optional output transaction with explicit cleanup.
Canonical image descriptor resolution matrix with explicit fallback and liveness policy.
Single compute descriptor preparation/bind transaction with native scratch lifetime.
Ordered shader rewrite pipeline; phase ordering is the contract and remains explicit.
One eye-image acquire/prepare/record transaction.
Atomic immutable draw/view snapshot capture.
One readback ownership and fence-transfer transaction.
One asynchronous depth readback ownership transaction.
Canonical synchronization scope/layout translation tables remain explicit and allocation-free.
One overlay admission, barrier, and secondary execution transaction.
Canonical primary record transaction with one prepared artifact result.
One-time command submission closes one native command/fence lifetime scope.
Native shared-image creation keeps Win32/Vulkan handle unwind in one scope.
Canonical blit validation and command emission matrix.
